name: DLR-NeRF Construction
aliases: DLR-NeRF Construction (Network Distillation via TT Decomposition)
Distilled Low Rank Neural Radiance Field
Network Distillation via Tensor Train (TT) Decomposition
definition: A method to create a slimmer network (DLR-NeRF) from a low-rank NeRF (LR-NeRF) by decomposing weights into Tensor Train (TT) components and initializing new cascaded fully-connected layers, serving as a bridge between low-rank approximation and quantization.
summary: DLR-NeRF Construction is a network distillation method that decomposes low-rank NeRF weights into Tensor Train components to bridge low-rank approximation and quantization, preserving structural benefits for efficient compression.
